hypotheses.T0_source_decomposition_recomposes: The sum of source-position components matches the selected head/factor third-order residual within 1e-4 relative to the exact response in failure and control.
hypotheses.T1_source_path_is_sparse: At the failure, the largest source has at least 0.30 absolute projection share and effective source support is at most 10.
